anyOf.description: The owner-action condition as a mapping: `owner-action: …`.

owner-action.description: What to ask the owner before the step starts, for example whether a prototype is wanted. Engine effect: the step block tells the agent to ask; when the owner says no, the agent skips the step with `--skip`.

description.description: What the gate is for, in free text, for the reader. Engine effect: none.

anyOf.description: The check condition as a mapping: `check: …`.

check.description: A kind of check that the project's policy binds to a command. Engine effect: the command runs when the engine reaches the step; exit 0 runs the step, and any other result skips it. A kind bound to `none` runs the step; an unbound kind holds the step until the kind is bound.

description.description: What the gate is for, in free text, for the reader. Engine effect: none.

anyOf.description: The script condition as a mapping: `script: …`.

script.description: A shell command. Engine effect: it runs from the repository root when the engine reaches the step; exit 0 runs the step, and any other result skips it.

description.description: What the gate is for, in free text, for the reader. Engine effect: none.

anyOf.description: The agent condition as a mapping: `agent: …`.

agent.description: When the step applies, as the agent judges it. Engine effect: the step block tells the agent to do the step only if this holds, and otherwise to skip it with `--skip`.

description.description: What the gate is for, in free text, for the reader. Engine effect: none.
